blind.description: A wooden coat rack/hatstand bearing a purple wizard robe with yellow/gold trim and topped with a pointed purple wizard hat with a gold band. The stand features a carved wooden central post with rounded peg hooks and four curved wooden feet resting directly on the ground. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and stylized/cartoony with clean stylized textures and no unpainted areas or glow effects.
blind.from_above: A circular purple brim of a wizard hat with a pointed cone tip bending to the right, showing yellow robe cuffs poking out at the sides, casting a clear wizard-shaped shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 5 feet 3 inches to 5 feet 6 inches tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in scale figure) and about 2 feet wide across the base and sleeves.
